cohort: Use the original 12 early two-session windows, all 123 question IDs and their existing trace-linked states. Record the current cutoff before fitting or requesting any new crossed reader. The discovery case conv-44_s1 q7 already had an activity-vs-relation +0.92 adjudication and a temporal answer with F1 1. The conv-42_s3 q105 veto was also seen. Include every judged window and every original question at the cutoff; also run an independently frozen final wave at completion of all 12. Keep missing, vetoed and ineligible rows explicit. Target histories are excluded in their entirety, including old and early training windows. Do not use formal evaluations.
reuse: Check three physically observed candidate responses, their exact prompts, context, native answer tokens and question identities. Require a unique deployed F1 outlier against two tied peers and local source evidence. To support a negative outlier, both high answers must recover the reference from the same low answer. Exact weaker-branch repairs under the same predecision state and original weak action are independent of which high answer is used for comparison: authenticate original and repaired reader requests against the archived prepared weak contexts, evaluate execution, retrieval and format using rule 2, and reuse that physical weak audit for both comparisons. For a positive outlier each distinct losing action requires its own physical weak audit. A veto from any required weak action sets the unique-choice credit to zero. If any required weak audit is missing, collect the missing comparison with the same repair protocol. A shared weak audit remains one source of causal evidence.
measurement: On every certified new question execute the temporal, activity and relationship archived writer receipts at the original early decision, each under both source groupings. Reuse byte-identical same-backend readers only. Require each deployed bank, ordered indices, context, answer, F1 and token count to repeat. Decompose exceptional-minus-peer utility by the two marginal intervention orders. Mean the two comparisons and cap signed shares to one original difference; track failed cases.
policy: Append all matched early windows with their original denominators to the ten original donors. Freeze an interim actor after full six-cell adjudication of the initial cutoff, then a final actor when all 12 early windows have final status. Preserve the original three-action raw gate, temperature and 20% checkpoint mixture. Learn outlier logit perturbations using separately measured template and grouping shares. Compare identical design with new labels zeroed, no credit, total instead of component credit, rotated labels, swapped heads, the previous six-cell actor and native. All early results remain training diagnostics, comparisons within an early target exclude its whole history. Record prospective later coverage at each freeze and the existing 18-window/161-question gain bounds.
